brief.name: QUM
brief.offer: Skincare made in small batches on the Absheron coast, with Caspian salt and saffron grown a few kilometres inland. Six products, one ritual.

pages.label: Home
pages.purpose: Establish mood and promise in seconds; orient the visitor to what this site is and give them a clear next step.

pages.label: Shop
pages.purpose: Let visitors browse and choose confidently.

pages.label: Product
pages.purpose: Show one product in full: gallery, price, variants, add-to-cart, and related items.

pages.label: Cart
pages.purpose: Let visitors review and adjust their selection before checkout.

pages.label: Checkout
pages.purpose: Collect payment and shipping with as little friction as possible.

pages.label: The salt
pages.purpose: Where QUM comes from: the salt pans at Masazir, the saffron fields at Bilgah, the small lab in Mardakan, and the three people who make every batch.

pages.label: Journal
pages.purpose: Show ongoing thinking, in your own voice, over time.

pages.label: Article
pages.purpose: Let people read one story well: title, summary, author and date, a calm reading column with pull quotes and pictures, then what to read next.

pages.label: Help
pages.purpose: Answer the questions that would otherwise stall a decision.
